name: Vernon Hills
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Vernon Hills, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Vernon Hills, IL: the Village tree lighting at Hawthorn Row, Santa photos and Sensory Santa at Hawthorn, and Breakfast with Santa.
lede: Vernon Hills celebrates Christmas around Hawthorn, its shopping center since 1973: the Village lights its holiday tree there, Santa holds court on the lower level all season, and families gather for breakfast with Santa next door.
celebrates: The season in Vernon Hills starts with the Village's Holiday Light Celebration, a free outdoor party where the Village Tree, Menorah and Kinara are lit together. Santa arrives with help from the village's partners at Countryside Fire, and Public Works puts up more lighted displays around town. Hawthorn runs the Hawthorn Christmas Experience, where Santa poses for photos from mid November to Christmas Eve, with Baby's First Christmas days and a quiet Sensory Friendly Santa morning. Dave & Buster's at Hawthorn hosts an annual Breakfast with Santa, and the Vernon Hills Park District adds holiday classes for young children.
lastyear: In 2025 the Holiday Light Celebration was set for Saturday, November 29, at 4:30 pm in Century Park, at the corner of Hawthorn and Lakeview Parkways. Mayor Koch and special guests were to light the Village Tree, Menorah and Kinara, with treats from a food truck and a visit from a special guest in a big red suit. A winter storm with heavy snow canceled it that evening, and the celebration was rescheduled for Friday, December 5, at 6:30 pm in Century Park.
facts: Vernon Hills is young for a Chicago suburb. Voters approved incorporating the village 45 to 1 on July 15, 1958, and early residents had first used the name Forest Hills. Hawthorn Center opened on September 10, 1973, designed to look like the shopping streets of Europe, with brick paved halls and old fashioned street lights. For years the Cuneo Mansion and Gardens ran a Winter Wonderland Holiday Light Show; in the 2013 season it was open nightly from 6 to 10 pm for $5 a car on weeknights.
trains: The Vernon Hills Metra station sits at 75 East Route 45 on the North Central Service. It is accessible, has 646 parking spaces and no ticket machine, so riders buy tickets on board or in the Ventra app, and Pace route 593 connects there. Metra's 2026 Holiday Trains run on other lines, such as Milwaukee District North on December 5. In 2022 the Vernon Hills Park District offered a Polar Express Storytime Train from the Libertyville Metra station to Fox Lake and back, with carols, treats and Santa.

kidfact: Hawthorn opened in 1973 with brick paved hallways and old fashioned street lamps, built to look like a shopping street in Europe. Today Santa visits there every Christmas.
faq: Where does Vernon Hills light its holiday tree?

The Village of Vernon Hills lights its tree at the Holiday Light Celebration, a free family event. It was held in Century Park for recent seasons, at the corner of Hawthorn and Lakeview Parkways, and in 2026 the village moved it to Hawthorn Row next to Yard House for more activities, better visibility and places to warm up.
Does Vernon Hills light a menorah and kinara too?

Yes. The Village lights its holiday tree, a menorah and a kinara together at the Holiday Light Celebration. In 2025 Mayor Koch and special guests were scheduled to do the lighting at Century Park, and the event is billed as a free, family friendly outdoor celebration open to everyone.
Where can kids see Santa in Vernon Hills?

Hawthorn hosts Santa in the Hawthorn Christmas Experience on the lower level in H&M Court from mid November until Christmas Eve. Reservations are recommended, walk ups are welcome when there is space, and the mall adds special times such as Baby's First Christmas days and a Sensory Friendly Santa morning.
Is there a sensory friendly Santa in Vernon Hills?

Yes. Hawthorn holds a Sensory Friendly Santa, described as a quiet time at the mall with Santa, on a Sunday morning in early December in H&M Court. Families reserve a spot ahead through the mall's Santa booking page, and each child receives a gift and treats from Maggiano's.
Which Metra station serves Vernon Hills?

The Vernon Hills station at 75 East Route 45 is on Metra's North Central Service. It is accessible and has two parking lots with 646 spaces. There is no ticket machine, so riders buy tickets on board or with the Ventra app, and Pace route 593 stops there.
